releases.displayName: Server Maintenance Complete & Small Patch Live ✅ | Headbangers: Rhythm Royale

items.text: Hey Flock! 👋🐤
Our temporary downtime for Headbangers: Rhythm Royale is now complete on Steam. ✅ Thank you for your patience whilst we ran scheduled maintenance of our multiplayer servers!
Alongside this maintenance, we've released a small patch to fix a handful of issues with Headbangers: Rhythm Royale. Please find more about the fixes in our Patch Notes below:

Fixed an issue where some music tracks were not accessible in the track pool for certain minigames, including Run Pigeon Run and Piano Mezzo Forte. As a result of this fix, more music track options are now accessible for these minigames!
Fixed an issue with the challenge to spend Crumbs, which did not work as intended, as the player would not receive challenge progress when spending Crumbs.
Fixed an issue with the challenge to make purchases in the store, where the challenge would not update if the player bought items too quickly.
Fixed an occasional issue where items that cannot be purchased would not be highlighted in red, appearing purchasable.

We want to thank the community for reporting these issues, especially around the specific music track minigames issue, which we're happy to have fixed in this patch. We hope you enjoy experiencing and sticking to the rhythm of these minigame tracks, especially for the Run Pigeon Run and Piano Mezzo Forte minigames! 🎵
If players have any issues with our game or run into any bugs, please reach out to our Support Team here!

We want to let you know about an important update.

A recently identified security vulnerability within Unity has been spotted, and while there is currently no evidence of impact on users, we’re taking all relevant steps to ensure you’re on the latest and safest version of the game.
To keep you safe, we’ve released a new patch that addresses the issue. Please update your game as soon as possible to stay protected.

notes.title: You can read more about it here

items.text: As always, our priority will be on keeping our games as safe and enjoyable for everyone.

releases.displayName: Coming with Season 3: Steam Cloud Saves I Headbangers: Rhythm Royale

items.text: Hey Flock! 👋🐤
Season 3 & Battle of the Dancers will launch at 2PM BST on April 4th! Included in this update, is a small tweak to Headbangers which will activate the Steam Cloud Save feature.

Unfortunately, we have no control over which save file will be uploaded to the Steam Cloud. We'd recommend to players who've played Headbangers: Rhythm Royale on multiple devices to play first on your device with the local save that you'd want to keep from 4 April 2024 14:00 BST onwards. This is to ensure the correct save file is uploaded to Steam Cloud.

We're excited to implement Steam Cloud Save and for progress to translate between players' multiple devices. For Multi-PC and Steam Deck users, we hope this feature helps you hit all the levels on your new Season 3 Battle Pass!
If players have any issues with Steam Cloud Saves or run into any bugs, please reach out to our Support Team here!
If you have any feedback or suggestions around Headbangers: Rhythm Royale, please head to our #feedback channel in our Headbangers Discord!

The third hotfix is now live for Headbangers: Rhythm Royale for all platforms! Hotfix 3 reduces the lobby timer to 60 seconds and contains fixes to the lobby backfill bugs, fixes to specific challenges and more.

Before we soar into more information around the hotfix, we would like to inform the community that the team are working on an issue surrounding a network error, preventing some players from launching the game. Once we have a fix, we will update the community with this news. We hope to have a fix for this soon across all platforms and appreciate the community's patience while we remedy this issue.

notes.title: After listening to players' feedback from our launch week, we have altered the lobby timer and fixed an issue surrounding lobby backfill! 🤟

items.text: At launch, our lobby timer was set to 120 seconds. Many players stated that this timer was too long, that players were leaving lobbies before the two-minute mark and that we should reduce this timer. With Hotfix 3, we have reduced this timer to 60 seconds. Now, players will spend less time in the lobby menu and more time playing our rhythm minigames! 🎧

On our October 31st launch, many community members noticed a bug around players leaving lobbies. When a player left an open lobby, a bug caused the lobby to never refill back to 30 players. In Hotfix 3, we have fixed this issue with server backfill. With Hotfix 3, if players leave during the timer screen, the lobby can still fill back to 30 players. Full lobbies for all! 🥳
Reduced the lobby waiting time to 60 seconds.
Fixed an issue with the server backfill to ensure remaining free slots in a lobby are filled with players.
Fixed an issue where the challenge outfit for the Aubergine skin would not unlock if a disconnection occurs.
Fixed an issue around Crumb Unlocks. Future crumb level unlocks in the battle pass will be rewarded as the bug around Crumb Unlocks, which would sometimes not be awarded, is now fixed.*
Fixed an issue where the sound effects would be missing when using the Team17 overlay.

*At this moment, we have fixed this issue for future Crumbs Level unlocks. If you unlocked a crumbs pack before Hotfix 3 and encountered this issue, your Crumb total will not be fixed. We will continue the investigation into this issue and provide further information around this bug in the future.
We want to thank the community for your detailed feedback and your overall patience, whilst our team has investigated these issues!
If you run into any server issues or any other problems with Headbangers: Rhythm Royale, please don’t hesitate to contact our Support Team.
If you have any feedback or suggestions around Headbangers: Rhythm Royale, please head to our #feedback channel in our Headbangers Discord!
That's all for now Flock, have a great day! 🐥

notes.title: Hey Flock! 👋🐤 The second hotfix is NOW LIVE for Headbangers: Rhythm Royale on Steam.

items.text: Hotfix 2 fixes the issue preventing players from launching the game due to network errors and contains specific fixes to the in-game shop. We want to thank you all for your significant feedback since our launch last week!
Fixed an issue where some players were prevented from launching the game.
Fixed an issue where some players would experience intermittent issues when connecting with the servers.
Fixed an issue where some players were not able to access the in-game shop and would be stuck in a loading loop.
We'd also like to thank the community for your patience, whilst our team has investigated these issues!
If you do run into any bugs in Headbangers, please get in contact with our Support Team here.
If you have any feedback or suggestions around Headbangers: Rhythm Royale, please head to our #feedback channel in our Headbangers Discord!
That's all for now Flock, have a great day! 🐥
